autonomous.title: Create Novel from EPUB
autonomous.subtitle: Upload a reference novel you have the right to analyse. NovelForge learns its structure, offers original storylines, and writes, validates and exports a complete novel. You only choose a storyline and a chapter count.
autonomous.dropFile: Drop an EPUB here or click to choose (EPUB, TXT, Markdown, DOCX)

pref.title: Working title
pref.author: Author name
pref.notes_placeholder: Anything the novel must honour that the brief does not already say; becomes a fixed requirement.
pref.summary_placeholder: e.g. A corporate accountant transmigrates into an indebted noble heir and uses forensic ledger analysis...

autonomous.prefNote: Everything you fill in here becomes a fixed requirement in the novel's Story Charter. Anything you leave empty stays an open choice the planner may decide — nothing is silently defaulted.

brief.title: Describe the novel you want
brief.hint: A sentence or several pages — protagonist, world, progression, relationships, tone, themes, structure, boundaries, length, ending, and what you want to leave open.
brief.placeholder: e.g. A disgraced court accountant discovers the empire's magic runs on debt. I want a scheming, dry-humoured protagonist who wins with ledgers before swords, a visible power tier system, no love triangle, chapters that end on hooks. I have not decided the ending or whether the mentor survives.
brief.charterNote: Your brief and preferences are saved as the project's Story Charter: visible and editable in the Novel Bible, and sent to every planning and chapter prompt so requirements do not fade after the first chapters.

autonomous.rightsNotice: Only manuscripts you have the right to analyse are processed. The reference's names, settings, scenes, twists and wording are never reused; only abstract structural qualities inform the new novel.

preflight.title: Provider preflight
preflight.required: Run the preflight (or acknowledge starting without it) before creating a job.

webnovel.title: Korean webnovel style
webnovel.hint: The novel is written in English with the conventions of a top-tier Korean webnovel: one-line rhythm, dense inner speech, status windows where the world has them, a face-slap reward cadence and a hook in the last line of every chapter. Leave anything on "let the engine decide" and it is detected from your brief and the reference; set it and it becomes law for every chapter.
webnovel.subgenreHint: Sets the progression engine: what grows, the tier ladder, what counts as a win, the world hooks that manufacture episodes.

windows.off: No — no windows in this world

webnovel.directivesHint: Notes in your own words that reach every planning and drafting prompt. One per line; scope them to arcs or chapters later in the Director.
webnovel.directivesPlaceholder:
The protagonist never begs.
Rank-ups are earned on the page, never off-screen.
No love triangle.
webnovel.autoStartHint: Off: the job is created paused so you can edit the style profile and directives in the Director before analysis starts.
